Dholuo: Skunde ma pi nyalo chue yudo Ksh 10M ng'ato ka ng'ato mondo otigo tij lwoko pi chakre Wuok Tich!
Somali: Dugsiyada daadka u nugul waxay helayaan Ksh 10M mid kasta oo ka mid ah hawlaha qulqulka ayaa bilaabanaya Isniinta!

English: Form 1–4: Register as voters this week or miss 2027 elections!
Kiswahili: Kidato cha 1–4: Jiandikishe kama wapiga kura wiki hii au ukose uchaguzi wa 2027!
Dholuo: Form 14: Riwri e kwan mar joma biro goyo ombulu juma ka juma, ka ok kamano to ok ibi dhi e yiero mar 2027!
Somali: Foomka 1aad ee 4aad: Isdiiwaangaliya sida codbixiyeyaasha toddobaadkan ama ka maqnaada doorashada 2027!

English: Form One reporting starts January 6 – bring only admission letter and birth certificate.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti kidato cha kwanza kunaanza Januari 6 – leta barua ya udahili na cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee.
Dholuo: Form One biro chakore e Januar 6 biro mana gi barupe mag rwako ji e skul kod satifiket mar nyuol.
Somali: Warbixinta foomka koowaad waxay bilaabmaysaa 6-da Janaayo, waxaad keeni kartaa oo keliya waraaqaha gelitaanka iyo shahaadada dhalashada.

English: Free 100GB data for all KCSE 2025 candidates – activate with candidate number NOW!
Kiswahili: Data ya bure ya GB 100 kwa watahiniwa wote wa KCSE 2025 – anzisha kwa nambari ya mgombea SASA!
Dholuo: Ng'eny mar data mar GB 100 ma onge chudo ne jogo duto ma dhi e KCSE 2025, timuru kamano sani!
Somali: 100GB oo xog ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan musharixiinta KCSE 2025 ayaa hadda la shaqeynayaa lambarka musharixiinta!

English: Free 200GB data bundle for all teachers – activate with TSC number before Dec 31!
Kiswahili: Kifurushi cha data cha GB 200 bila malipo kwa walimu wote – anzisha kwa nambari ya TSC kabla ya Desemba 31!
Dholuo: Keth mar data mar 200GB ma onge chudo ne jopuonj duto ma tiyo gi namba mar TSC kapok Desemba 31 ochopo!
Somali: 200GB oo xog ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay macalimiinta oo dhan ayaa lagu shaqeyn doonaa lambarka TSC ka hor 31-ka Diseembar!

English: Free Adobe Creative Cloud for all university students – claim with .ac.ke email NOW!
Kiswahili: Wingu la Bure la picha na vikaragosi.... Adobe Creative kwa wanafunzi wote wa vyuo vikuu – dai kwa barua pepe ya .ac.ke SASA!
Dholuo: Adobe Creative Cloud ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre duto mag yunivasiti manyisogi gi .ac.ke e-mail KARO!
Somali: Adobe Creative Cloud oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan ardayda jaamacadaha ayaa codsanaya emaylka .ac.ke HALKAN!

English: Free AI & robotics courses for 8,000 youth – register via TVETA portal TODAY!
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za AI na roboti kwa vijana 8,000 – jiandikishe kupitia lango la TVETA LEO!
Dholuo: Puonjruok mar AI & robotics ma onge chudo ne rowere 8,000, donj e TVETA kawuono!
Somali: Koorsooyin bilaash ah oo AI & robotics ah oo loogu talagalay 8,000 dhalinyaro ah ayaa iska diiwaangelinaya bogga TVETA maanta!

English: Free bus fare for all TVET students reporting in January – present your admission letter.
Kiswahili: Nauli ya basi bila malipo kwa wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanaoripoti Januari wasilisha barua yako ya kujiunga.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ang'ata ma dhi e TVET dwe mar Januar nyaka nyis barupe mar kwayo.
Somali: Safarka baska ee bilaashka ah ee dhammaan ardayda TVET ee soo bandhiga bisha Janaayo waxay soo bandhigaan warqaddaada gelitaanka.

English: Free bus passes + laptops for all TVET reporters in January – collect from institute!
Kiswahili: Pasi za basi bila malipo + kompyuta mpakato kwa waandishi wote wa TVET mwezi Januari kusanya kutoka chuo!
Dholuo: Buge mag wuoth ma onge chudo + kompyuta mag lwedo ne jofwambo duto mag TVET e dwe mar Januar e riwruok!
Somali: Basaska bilaashka ah + laptops-ka dhammaan wariyeyaasha TVET ee bisha Janaayo ayaa laga soo ururiyaa machadka!

English: Free bus passes for all TVET students reporting in January – collect from principal.
Kiswahili: Pasi za basi bila malipo kwa wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanaoripoti Januari kusanya kutoka kwa mkuu wa shule.
Dholuo: Buge mag wuoth ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre duto mag TVET ma biro e dwe mar Januar, ichoko kuom japuonj maduong'.
Somali: Baasaboorka baska ee bilaashka ah ee dhammaan ardayda TVET ee soo bandhiga bisha Janaayo waxaa laga soo qaataa macalinka.

English: Free coding bootcamps for 10,000 youth – register via TVETA portal now.
Kiswahili: Kambi za mafunzo ya uandishi wa habari bila malipo kwa vijana 10,000 jiandikishe kupitia lango la TVETA sasa.
Dholuo: Kambi mar program ma onge chudo ne rowere 10,000 ma donjo e TVETA sani.
Somali: Shaqooyinka barnaamijyada barnaamijka ee bilaashka ah ee loogu talagalay 10,000 oo dhalinyaro ah ayaa hadda ka diiwaangashan bogga TVETA.

English: Free counseling for exam stress – call 0800721524 or visit school counselor!
Kiswahili: Ushauri nasaha bila malipo kwa msongo wa mawazo wa mtihani piga simu 0800721524 au tembelea mshauri wa shule!
Dholuo: Kony ma onge chudo kuom parruok mag penj luong 0800721524 kata dhi ir jakony mar skul!
Somali: La talinta bilaashka ah ee imtixaanka stress wac 0800721524 ama booqo lataliyaha dugsiga!

English: Free data bundles for all KCSE candidates until March 2026 – no zero-rating needed!
Kiswahili: Vifurushi vya data bila malipo kwa watahiniwa wote wa KCSE hadi Machi 2026 hakuna alama ya sifuri inayohitajika!
Dholuo: Buge ma onge chudo ne joma dwaro timo penj mar KCSE nyaka Mach 2026, onge kwan mar joma ok dwar timo penj!
Somali: Qeybaha xogta ee bilaashka ah ee dhammaan musharixiinta KCSE illaa Maarso 2026 - looma baahna qiimeyn eber ah!

English: Free day secondary capitation increased to Ksh 22,244 per student – confirm with your principal.
Kiswahili: Kiasi cha bure cha masomo ya sekondari kimeongezwa hadi Ksh 22,244 kwa kila mwanafunzi thibitisha na mkuu wako wa shule.
Dholuo: Chiwo mar odiechieng' maonge chudo mar sekondar omedore mochopo Ksh 22,244 ne japuonjre ka japuonjre.
Somali: Xisaabta dugsiga sare ee maalinta bilaashka ah ayaa kor u kacday ilaa Ksh 22,244 arday kasta oo la xaqiijiyay agaasimaha dugsiga.

English: Free digital library with 50,000 books launched – no login needed!
Kiswahili: Maktaba ya bure ya kidijitali yenye vitabu 50,000 yazinduliwa – hakuna haja ya kuingia!
Dholuo: Ohinga mar Intanet ma onge chudo ma oting'o buge 50,000 osechako tich maonge chuno ni ng'ato odonj e intanet!
Somali: Maktabadda dhijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah oo leh 50,000 oo buugaag ayaa la bilaabay, looma baahna inaad gasho!

English: Free Google Workspace for all Kenyan teachers – claim your account today!
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya Kazi ya Google ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya – dai akaunti yako leo!
Dholuo: Google Workspace ma onge chudo ne jopuonj duto ma Kenya, manyuru kwan mar akaunt maru kawuono!
Somali: Google Workspace oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan macalimiinta Kenya ayaa maanta dalbanaya koontadaada!

English: Free holiday tuition for 50,000 Grade 8 learners starts Dec 1 – register now!
Kiswahili: Karibisho la likizo la bure kwa wanafunzi 50,000 wa Darasa la 8 linaanza Desemba 1 – jiandikishe sasa!
Dholuo: Somo maonge chudo ne jopuonjre 50,000 mag klas 8 chakore Dec 1 ondikre sani!
Somali: Waxbarashada fasaxa ee lacag la'aanta ah ee 50,000 ardayda fasalka 8aad waxay bilaabmaysaa 1da Diseembar.

English: Free KCSE 2025 mock papers for all subjects uploaded – download before midnight crash!
Kiswahili: Karatasi za majaribio za KCSE 2025 bila malipo kwa masomo yote yaliyopakiwa – Pakua kabla ya ajali ya usiku wa manane!
Dholuo: KCSE mar 2025 ma onge chudo mag somo duto ma ng'ato nyalo ting'o kod ma ng'ato nyalo download kapok ochopo chuny otieno!
Somali: Warqado been abuur ah oo KCSE 2025 ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhamaan mawduucyada la soo gudbiyay ayaa lagala soo bixi doonaa ka hor inta aan la dhicin saqdii dhexe!

English: Free KCSE 2025 past papers uploaded – download before servers crash tonight!
Kiswahili: Pata karatasi za zamani za KCSE 2025 bila malipo kabla ya ajali ya seva usiku wa leo!
Dholuo: KCSE mar 2025 ma onge chudo osetundo e ng'icho.
Somali: KCSE 2025 oo lacag la'aan ah warqadaha la soo gudbiyay waa lagala soo bixi doonaa ka hor inta server-yada aanay dhicin caawa!

English: Free laptops for all KCSE 2025 candidates who register as voters – IEBC incentive.
Kiswahili: Pata kompyuta mpakato bila malipo kwa wagombea wote wa KCSE 2025 wanaojiandikisha kama wapiga kura – motisha ya IEBC.
Dholuo: Laptop ma onge chudo ne jogo duto ma dhi e penj mar KCSE 2025 ma oketo nyinggi e IEBC.
Somali: Laptops bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan musharixiinta KCSE 2025 ee isdiiwaangaliya codbixiyeyaasha - dhiirigelinta IEBC.

English: Free menstrual cups for 1 million schoolgirls – collect from health center this week!
Kiswahili: Vikombe vya hedhi vya bure kwa wasichana milioni 1 wa shule 2020 vinavyokusanywa kutoka kituo cha afya wiki hii!
Dholuo: Ng'iewo okombe mag chwero remo kuom nyiri 1 milion ma dhi e skunde, ibiro chok e kar thieth e jumani!
Somali: Koobka caadada ee lacag la'aanta ah ee 1 milyan oo gabdhood ah ayaa toddobaadkan laga soo qaadi doonaa xarunta caafimaadka!

English: Free national digital library launched – 100,000 books, no login required!
Kiswahili: Maktaba ya kitaifa ya kidijitali ya bure yazinduliwa – Vitabu 100,000, hakuna kuingia kunakohitajika!
Dholuo: Laibrari mar piny mangima mar digital ma onge chudo, ne ogolo buge 100,000, maonge chuno mar donjo!
Somali: Maktabadda Digitaalka Qaranka ee Bilaashka ah ayaa la bilaabay 100,000 oo buug, looma baahna inaad gasho!

English: Free national revision TV channel launches Dec 1 – KBC Channel 23, 24/7!
Kiswahili: Chaneli ya televisheni ya kitaifa ya marekebisho ya bure yazinduliwa Desemba 1 – KBC Channel 23, 24/7!
Dholuo: Ohinga mar TV mar KBC mar nono kendo nono weche manyien ma onge chudo chako tich Desemba 1 Ohinga mar Jarito mar 23, 24/7!
Somali: Telefishanka dib-u-eegista qaranka ee bilaashka ah wuxuu bilaabmayaa 1-da Diseembar KBC Channel 23, 24/7!

English: Free online CBC Grade 9 revision classes start Monday – register via e-Citizen.
Kiswahili: Madarasa ya bure ya marekebisho ya darasa la 9 ya CBC mtandaoni yanaanza Jumatatu – jiandikishe kupitia e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Somo mag nono weche mag CBC Grade 9 ma onge chudo chakore chieng' Tich Ariyo.
Somali: Casharrada dib-u-eegista ee bilaashka ah ee CBC ee fasalka 9aad waxay bilaabmaan Isniinta.

English: Free revision camp for 10,000 KCSE candidates starts tomorrow – register now!
Kiswahili: Kambi ya bure ya marekebisho kwa watahiniwa 10,000 wa KCSE inaanza kesho – jiandikishe sasa!
Dholuo: Kambi mar nono kendo somo mar nono weche manyien kuom 10,000 mag KCSE chakore kiny.
Somali: Xerada dib-u-eegista oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay 10,000 musharixiinta KCSE waxay bilaabaneysaa berrito. Isdiiwaangelinta hadda!

English: Free revision camp for 20,000 KCSE candidates starts Dec 1 – register now!
Kiswahili: Kambi ya bure ya marekebisho kwa watahiniwa 20,000 wa KCSE inaanza Desemba 1 – jiandikishe sasa!
Dholuo: Kambi mar nono kendo somo mar nono kendo somo mar jo KCSE 20,000 chako Dec. 1 - donj sani!
Somali: Xerada dib u eegista bilaashka ah ee 20,000 musharixiinta KCSE waxay bilaabaneysaa 1-da Diseembar diiwaangelinta hadda!

English: Free revision timetable + notes for all subjects – download from education.go.ke NOW!
Kiswahili: Ratiba ya bure ya marekebisho + maelezo kwa masomo yote – pakua kutoka education.go.ke SASA!
Dholuo: Chenro mar nono kendo nono weche duto ma ne osomo, ma onge chudo, inyalo yudogi e websait mar education.go.ke KINDEGI!
Somali: Jadwalka dib-u-eegista oo bilaash ah + qoraallo loogu talagalay dhammaan maadooyinka - ka soo dejiso education.go.ke NOW!

English: Free sanitary towels + underwear for 2 million girls – collect from class teacher!
Kiswahili: Taulo za usafi za bure + nguo za ndani kwa wasichana milioni 2 – kusanya kutoka kwa mwalimu wa darasa!
Dholuo: Sanduge mag lwoko del ma onge chudo kaachiel gi lewni ma iye ne nyithindo ma nyiri ma kwan-gi romo milion 2 ma ne ochoki kuom japuonjgi!
Somali: Qalabka caafimaadka ee lacag la'aanta ah + dharka hoostiisa ee 2 milyan oo gabdhood ah ayaa laga helaa macalinka fasalka!

English: Free sanitary towels delivered to all public schools – principals must distribute today.
Kiswahili: Taulo za usafi za bure zinazowasilishwa kwa shule zote za umma – wakuu wa shule lazima wazisambaze leo.
Dholuo: Sanduge mag lwoko del ma onge chudo ma itero ne jotend skunde duto mag sirkal nyaka pog kawuono.
Somali: Towallada caafimaadka ee lacag la'aanta ah ee la gaarsiiyo dhamaan dugsiyada dadweynaha waa in maanta la qaybiyaa macallimiinta.

English: Free school uniforms for 500,000 Grade 7 learners – collection starts Monday.
Kiswahili: Sare za shule bila malipo kwa wanafunzi 500,000 wa Darasa la 7 – ukusanyaji unaanza Jumatatu.
Dholuo: Yudo lep skul ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre 500,000 mag klas mar 7 chakore Tich Ariyo.
Somali: Dharka dugsiga oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay 500,000 arday oo fasalka 7aad ayaa laga bilaabaa Isniinta.

English: Free sign-language interpreters in 500 schools – request via principal!
Kiswahili: Wakalimani wa lugha ya ishara bila malipo katika shule 500 – ombi kupitia mkuu wa shule!
Dholuo: Loko dhok mar ranyisi ma onge chudo e skunde 500 kwayo kokalo kuom jatelo maduong'!
Somali: Turjubaanada afka calaamadaha ah ee bilaashka ah ee 500 dugsi ayaa codsi ka bixiya madaxa dugsiga!

English: Free TVET courses in AI, robotics & coding – 5,000 slots open countrywide.
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za TVET katika AI, roboti na uandishi wa msimbo – Nafasi 5,000 zimefunguliwa kote nchini.
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiegruok e yore mag TVET e yore mag AI, robotics & koding, thuolo mar 5,000 oseyawore e piny mangima.
Somali: Koorsooyinka TVET ee lacag la'aanta ah ee AI, robotics & codinta waa 5,000 oo boos oo laga furay waddanka oo dhan.

English: Free uniforms for 600,000 Grade 7 learners – collect from school starting Monday!
Kiswahili: Sare za bure kwa wanafunzi 600,000 wa Darasa la 7 – zilizokusanywa kutoka shuleni kuanzia Jumatatu!
Dholuo: Yunifom ma onge chudo ne jopuonjre maromo 600,000 mar klas 7 ochok e skul chakre Tich Ariyo!
Somali: Dharka lacag la'aanta ah ee 600,000 ardayda fasalka 7aad ayaa laga soo ururiyaa dugsiga laga bilaabo Isniinta!

English: Free voter education app launched – scan QR code in your classroom today.
Kiswahili: Programu ya elimu ya mpiga kura bila malipo imezinduliwa – skani msimbo wa QR darasani mwako leo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar somo ne jotim yiero ma onge chudo ne ochak tiyo sani mar scan QR code e klas.
Somali: Barnaamijka waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee bilaashka ah ayaa maanta la bilaabay si ay u baaraan koodhka QR ee fasalkaaga.

English: Free voter education WhatsApp bot launched – save 0111222333 and type HI now!
Kiswahili: Boti ya elimu ya mpiga kura ya WhatsApp imezinduliwa – hifadhi 0111222333 na andika HI sasa!
Dholuo: WhatsApp bot mar somo ne joma oyiero ma onge chudo osechako tiyo.
Somali: Waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha bilaashka ah botka WhatsApp ayaa la bilaabay

English: Free Zoom Pro for all Kenyan teachers – claim with TSC number today!
Kiswahili: Zoom Pro ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya – dai kwa nambari ya TSC leo!
Dholuo: Zoom Pro ma onge chudo ne jopuonj duto mag Kenya ma nigi namba mar TSC kawuono!
Somali: Zoom Pro oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan macalimiinta Kenya ayaa codsanaya lambarka TSC maanta!

English: GBV desks active in every public school – report anonymously today!
Kiswahili: Madawati ya GBV yanafanya kazi katika kila shule ya umma – ripoti bila kujulikana leo!
Dholuo: Buge mawuoyo kuom timbe gero mag nindruok e kind chwo gi mon, sani yudore e skunde duto mag sirkal!
Somali: Xafiisyada GBV ee ka shaqeeya dugsiyada dadweynaha oo dhan ayaa maanta si qarsoodi ah u soo waramaya!

English: Grade 7 free feeding program starts Jan – 3 meals daily guaranteed!
Kiswahili: Programu ya kulisha bila malipo ya Darasa la 7 inaanza Januari – Milo 3 kila siku imehakikishwa!
Dholuo: Chenro mar pidho nyithindo maonge chudo chakore Januar 3. Chiemo mapile en gima osingi!
Somali: Barnaamijka quudinta bilaashka ah ee fasalka 7aad wuxuu bilaabmayaa Jan, 3 cunto oo maalinle ah oo la damaanad qaaday!

English: Grade 7 reporting January 13: Bring only birth certificate – no shopping list allowed.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti Darasa la 7 Januari 13: Leta cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee – hakuna orodha ya ununuzi inayoruhusiwa.
Dholuo: Klas mar 7 biro chopo Januar 13: Inyalo mana kelo barupe manyiso ni onyuoli to ok iyie gi chenro mar nyiewo gik moko.
Somali: Qeybta 7aad ee warbixinta Janaayo 13: Keliya keena shahaadada dhalashada. Liiska wax iibsiga looma oggola.

English: IEBC launches digital voter education app – download now on Google Play.
Kiswahili: IEBC yazindua programu ya elimu ya wapiga kura kidijitali "pakua sasa" kwenye Google Play.
Dholuo: IEBC chako tiyo gi app mar somo ne joma oyiero e yor digital ma inyalo download sani e Google Play.
Somali: IEBC waxay bilaabaysaa barnaamijka waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha digital ah ee hadda laga soo dejisan karo Google Play.

English: IEBC to issue 1 million voter cards in schools next week – be ready!
Kiswahili: IEBC itatoa kadi za wapiga kura milioni 1 shuleni wiki ijayo "kuwa tayari!
Dholuo: IEBC biro golo kad mar yiero mar milion achiel e skunde juma mabiro beduru moikore!
Somali: IEBC waxay soo saari doontaa 1 milyan oo kaararka codbixiyaha ee iskuulada todobaadka soo socda.

English: IEBC to issue 500,000 voter cards in schools next week – be ready with ID!
Kiswahili: IEBC itatoa kadi za wapiga kura 500,000 shuleni wiki ijayo "kuwa tayari na kitambulisho!
Dholuo: IEBC biro golo kad 500,000 mag yiero e skunde juma mabiro ikreuru gi kad mar ID!
Somali: IEBC waxay toddobaadka soo socda u soo saari doontaa 500,000 kaararka codbixiyaha dugsiyada si ay u diyaar garoobaan aqoonsiga!

English: IEBC to visit 2,000 schools next week – ensure all Form 4 have voter cards.
Kiswahili: IEBC itatembelea shule 2,000 wiki ijayo ili kuhakikisha wanafunzi wote wa kidato cha 4 wana kadi za wapiga kura.
Dholuo: IEBC biro limo skunde 2,000 juma mabiro mondo one ni Form 4 duto nigi kad mag yiero.
Somali: IEBC waxay booqan doontaa 2,000 oo dugsi toddobaadka soo socda si loo hubiyo in dhammaan Form 4 ay leeyihiin kaararka codbixiyeyaasha.

English: IEBC voter registration in every school Nov 20–30 – bring ID or birth cert!
Kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC katika kila shule Novemba 20, 2020, 3 ... Ofisi ya mkuu SASA!
Dholuo: IEBC ndiko ji e ombulu e skunde duto Nov 2030 kel ID kata satifiket mar nyuol!
Somali: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ee iskuulada oo dhan 20 Noofembar 30 saacadood ka dib waxaad keentaa shahaadada aqoonsiga ama shahaadada dhalashada!

English: IEBC voter registration starts Monday – bring ID to your school or chief's office NOW!
Kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC unaanza Jumatatu. Lete kitambulisho shuleni kwako au ofisini kwa mkuu wa shule SASA!
Dholuo: IEBC chako ndiko ji e ombulu chieng' Tich Ariyo. Kel kad mar injili e skul kata e ofis mar jatend skul KINDEGI!
Somali: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC waxay bilaabmaysaa Isniinta. U keen aqoonsiga dugsigaaga ama xafiiska madaxaaga HADDII!

English: Inclusive CBC exams: Braille & sign language papers ready – collect from KNEC!
Kiswahili: Mitihani ya CBC jumuishi: Karatasi za Braille na lugha ya ishara tayari "kukusanywa kutoka KNEC!
Dholuo: Nonro mag CBC: Barupe mag Braille kod dhok mar ranyisi oikore mar kawo e KNEC!
Somali: Imtixaannada CBC oo ay ku jiraan: Imtixaannada Braille & Afka Calaamadaha ayaa diyaar u ah in laga soo qaado KNEC!

English: Inclusive education policy launched – every school must admit disabled learners!
Kiswahili: Sera ya elimu jumuishi yazinduliwa "kila shule lazima iwaandikishe wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!"
Dholuo: Chenro mar somo ma oriwo ji duto osechako skul ka skul nyaka yie rwako jopuonjre ma nigi midekre!
Somali: Siyaasadda waxbarashada oo dhanka ka mid ah ayaa la bilaabay. Dugsi kasta waa inuu aqbalaa ardayga naafada ah!

English: Inclusive sports day mandatory in all schools Dec 10 – every child must participate!
Kiswahili: Siku ya michezo jumuishi lazima katika shule zote Desemba 10 "kila mtoto lazima ashiriki!"
Dholuo: Odiechieng' mar tuke moriwo ji duto en gima ochuno e skunde duto Desemba 10 nyathi ka nyathi nyaka riwre!
Somali: Xilliga isboortiga oo dhan waxaa lagu qasbaa dhammaan dugsiyada 10-ka Diseembar. Ilmaha oo dhami waa inay ka qeyb galaan!

English: Intern teachers' salary jumps to Ksh 50,000 from January – TSC confirms!
Kiswahili: Mshahara wa walimu wa mafunzo ya ndani waongezeka hadi Ksh 50,000 kuanzia Januari TSC inathibitisha!
Dholuo: Pesa ma jopuonj ma interns yudo biro medore maromo Ksh 50,000 chakre Januar, TSC wacho kamano!
Somali: Macallimiinta shaqaalaysiinta ah ee shaqaalaysiinta ah waxay kor u qaadaan mushaharka Ksh 50,000 laga bilaabo Janaayo, sida ay xaqiijisay TSC!
